goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that trickle data without ever completing a request
Prevents slow connections from exhausting connection slots and blocking legitimate RPC clients
agreement: Nonblocking objection: loose test assertion could let early socket drops pass unnoticed (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because slow clients can hold RPC connection slots indefinitely and block legitimate users
Prevents unauthenticated slowloris-style connection exhaustion on the HTTP server
Impact is limited because the RPC interface binds to localhost by default
